entries.description:
Louis Vuitton Nano Speedy Monogram Canvas Handbag

This listing showcases the Louis Vuitton M81085 Nano Speedy, a miniature version of the brand’s iconic Speedy silhouette. Crafted from the classic monogram canvas, the bag is trimmed with natural Vachetta leather and accented by gold-tone hardware. Its compact dimensions—8 cm in depth, 10 cm in height, and 16.5 cm in width—make it a standout accessory for those seeking a luxury statement in a small package.

Accompanying the handbag are a detachable leather strap for crossbody wear, a branded dust cover for protection, and the original Louis Vuitton box. Priced at RM10,000 and identified by SKU MDG-3309-LV (N), this set offers both style and complete packaging for collectors and fashion enthusiasts alike.

entries.description:
Louis Vuitton Monogram Key Pouch S

This Louis Vuitton Monogram Key Pouch S is crafted from the brand’s signature brown monogram coated canvas, measuring 6 inches in length and 3.5 inches in height. The top zipper opens to a brown crossgrain leather interior, where a brass clasp is attached for clipping keys or securing the pouch to a handbag.

Offered in new condition, the pouch comes with a Fashionphile Certificate of Authenticity. Free domestic shipping is included, and returns are accepted within fifteen days of delivery if the item remains in its original condition with tags attached.
